subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should the access-request workflow be redesigned around the canonical accessGroups contract with explicit pre-auth activation, or should OpenClaw intentionally support this second fixed per-sender group taxonomy and automatic trusted-hook activation?
rationale: The implementation and proof cannot determine the permanent config/API model or authorize the pre-admission privacy boundary.

options.title: Refactor To Canonical Groups
options.body: Retain the pre-auth workflow but use accessGroups and accessGroup:<name>, expose matched groups as metadata, and require explicit activation for content-bearing hooks.

options.title: Approve Parallel Trust Tiers
options.body: Accept the six fixed labels and grouped allowlist objects as a distinct supported contract with explicit compatibility and security documentation.

options.title: Split Or Pause The Feature
options.body: Separate the generic pre-auth hook from grouping and access-request automation, or pause the broad proposal until a maintainer sponsors the complete direction.

recommendation.title: Refactor To Canonical Groups
recommendation.body: Retain the pre-auth workflow but use accessGroups and accessGroup:<name>, expose matched groups as metadata, and require explicit activation for content-bearing hooks.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the shared ingress, allowlist, config-mutation, and plugin SDK decision surface.
